bounds.name: total_cross_count_upper_bound

bounds.inference_if_excluded: Would rule out the +0.10 target under the registered count constraints; not observed
bounds.inference_if_not_excluded: Necessary count bound is nondecisive; does not prove construction or reachability

bounds.name: full_block_matrix_upper_bound
